description: Detect every face in a photo and store them in a collection so they can be found later by search_faces. Returns each face's point_id, bounding box (ratios of image width/height), detection score and pixel size. Faces below the quality gate (det_score < 0.6 or under 24 px) are counted as rejected. Indexing the same photo_id twice fails with already_indexed unless override=true. The collection is created if missing. Costs 93 credits.

file_path.description: Path to the photo on this computer (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF or HEIC).

gcs_key.description: Object key of the photo on the CDN configured for your account (instead of a URL).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry that reuses the key is never charged twice: if the first call finished, the retry gets 409 duplicate_request_already_processed; if it is still running, 409 duplicate_request_in_flight. Use a new key for each different request.

image_base64.description: The photo as base64 (a data: URL is fine). Up to 30 MB decoded. Prefer image_url for large files.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the photo. SightRadar downloads it; it must be reachable from the internet.

override.description: Re-index and replace the faces of a photo_id indexed before.

photo_id.description: Your id for the photo; search results return it. Defaults to a content hash.

name: index_photo
title: Index a photo
